title: Monstra-case justice march toward the Public Prosecutor's Office
location: Cair Park toward the Public Prosecutor's Office, Skopje; police blocked the march near the Foreign Affairs Ministry
organizer: Families of the accused and protest organizing council, as described by Portalb
participants_original: Portalb described several thousand citizens; Euronews Albania reported hundreds. The Helsinki Committee report did not give a count.
threshold_50_evidence: Both qualitative estimates, 'several thousand' and 'hundreds,' indicate more than 50 but conflict and do not support an exact count or numeric interval.

start_date.summary: Contemporaneous reports date the march to Jan29; Portalb's minute-by-minute account places its start around 13:00.

end_date.summary: At about 14:30 Portalb explicitly says the protest ended and participants left; police removed armored vehicles afterward. Day-only physical end is supported.

location.summary: The march began in Cair and moved toward the Public Prosecutor's Office; police blocked approach near the Foreign Affairs Ministry. Alsat's search-only Interior Ministry traffic notice gives the announced route, but is planning context rather than occurrence evidence.

scope.summary: A route march in Skopje is described, not separate events by stop or city.

organizer.summary: Families of the accused and an organizing council are associated with the march; opposition figures' presence does not make it solely partisan.

demands.summary: Organizers sought prosecutor Fatime Fetai's dismissal and a different judicial/prosecutorial outcome, and appealed to international actors. Domestic demands are explicit.

participants_original.summary: Portalb says several thousand; Euronews Albania says hundreds. Retain attributed estimates in tension.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Both qualitative estimates clearly exceed 50, while neither gives an exact count.

protester_violence.summary: Portalb reports some protesters throwing stones/objects; the Helsinki Committee attributes broken windows and property damage at the Foreign Affairs Ministry to participants. The Committee's March retrospective report also recalls stones, broken windows and damage to the Ministry entrance on Jan29; it is the same Helsinki Committee source family as S002/S034.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Police cordon prevented the crowd approaching the Prosecutor's Office and police used shock bombs; this supports crowd blocking/dispersal. Shock bombs do not establish gunfire.

state_response.arrests.summary: CIVICUS mentions later criminal/misdemeanor charges but does not establish arrests or detention; arrests remain unknown.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Reviewed reports do not establish whether officials received or negotiated demands; unknown, not coded no.

state_response.beatings.summary: No reviewed source establishes event-time police beatings; unknown, not coded no.

state_response.ignore.summary: No Jan29-specific ignore response is established. A prior Jan22 official comment was not transferred.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-specific killing is established; unknown, not inferred from silence.

state_response.shootings.summary: Portalb reports shock bombs, not gunfire; no source establishes shooting.

notes: Main January candidate. MHC says road blockage lasted several hours; Portalb gives an explicit physical end at about 14:30. Preserve day-only end and do not calculate duration. Around 14:00 the police cordon blocked approach; around 14:20 some stones/objects were thrown and police used shock bombs; at about 14:30 the march ended and participants left. Keep shootings, arrests, beatings, accommodation, ignore and killings unknown. CIVICUS's Feb26 clashes/arrests concern a separate later protest and are not transferred. Crowd estimates conflict qualitatively. Opposition parties' support does not make the event exclusively partisan. The Helsinki Committee's March report (S035) recalls Jan29 stones and damage while separately describing Feb26; it is the same source institution as S002/S034. Alsat's blocked page (S037) is an advance traffic announcement, not proof of execution.
open_questions: Check whether contemporary evidence establishes event-time arrests, negotiation or other response; charges alone do not establish arrests.
Review attribution and extent of participant property damage against original local coverage.

title: Philosophy students protest draft primary-education concept
location: Outside the Ministry of Education and Science, Skopje
organizer: Students from the Skopje Faculty of Philosophy; formal organizer not reported
threshold_50_evidence: No estimate of people physically present; plural 'students' does not establish at least 50.

start_date.summary: Contemporaneous MIA-attributed Kanal5 report dates the protest to Jan20.

location.summary: The report places protesters outside the Education Ministry in Skopje.

organizer.summary: Participants are identified as Faculty of Philosophy students; no formal organizer named.

demands.summary: Students demanded withdrawal of the draft primary-education concept and a public debate.

participants_original.summary: The article identifies student protesters but no number.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No numerical or qualitative crowd estimate supports the 50-person threshold.

notes: Kanal5 carries an MIA-attributed report; it is opened reader content, not independent Kanal5 reporting. Coordinator's later ordinary HTTPS check returned 403 for the same URL; retain the already-opened body with that access limitation. Physical end, size and event-time state response are unknown.
open_questions: Establish whether at least 50 people gathered.
Find an accessible same-day independent report or organizer account and physical end.

title: Accountants protest outside Government over reporting deadlines and accounting law
location: In front of the Government building, Skopje
threshold_50_evidence: No participant estimate; described group does not establish a 50-person crowd.

start_date.summary: 24.mk and CIVICUS date the physical protest to Jan26; Bankometar's prior-day notice is announcement evidence only.

location.summary: 24.mk says accountants protested in front of Government in Skopje.

scope.summary: A local gathering outside the central Government building is described.

organizer.summary: Accountants notified/held the protest; no named association is established.

demands.summary: The group sought tax/financial-report deadline extensions and a new accounting-work law.

participants_original.summary: Accountants identified but no number present.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count or size estimate establishes at least 50.

notes: 24.mk says a written request the prior week had received no reply; that preceded the protest and is not evidence of state ignore after Jan26. Continued demands/next steps do not establish when physical protest ended. Do not infer crowd size from the number of accountants nationally.
open_questions: Establish group size and whether further same-day activity continued.
Check for event-time official reception or other response.

title: Tursko Rudari residents block local road over proposed mini-hydropower plant
location: Local road to proposed mini-hydropower site, Tursko Rudari, Probistip municipality
organizer: Tursko Rudari residents; formal organizer not reported
threshold_50_evidence: No attendee count or estimate reported; threshold unresolved.

start_date.summary: Kanal5/MIA and CIVICUS report the protest on Jan27; the linked Sloboden Pechat English URL was blocked.

location.summary: Kanal5/MIA places the action at the local road to the proposed site in Tursko Rudari.

scope.summary: Residents blocked a local road; village-level action is described.

organizer.summary: Residents and the local-community president are identified; formal organizer is not.

demands.summary: Residents opposed the project over risks to vegetation, wildlife, irrigated farmland and the village water line; direct government addressee is not explicit.

protester_violence.summary: Local community president explicitly described the protest as peaceful.

state_response.accommodation.summary: A reported company meeting/private promise and mayor's permitting comments are not state reception/negotiation; accommodation remains unknown.

notes: Open MIA-attributed Kanal5 report supports occurrence and road block. Permitting status is background, not proof that protesters targeted government; mayor, company and state are not interchangeable. Private-company meeting/promise is not state accommodation. No size or end. Peacefulness statement supports no_explicit protester violence.
open_questions: Determine whether protesters explicitly addressed municipality, ministry or other government body, rather than only developer.

title: Undated high-school examination-related public-action lead (possible street protest/egg incident)
location: Skopje (Education Ministry site in the undated egg-throwing account) and Skopje/Kumanovo (partial street protests mentioned in search results); exact sites and relation unverified
scope: One or more possible public actions within the high-school examination dispute; dates and episode boundaries unresolved
participants_original: No street-gathering count. School/city boycott figures describe class participation, not simultaneous protest attendance.
threshold_50_evidence: No street-crowd count; threshold cannot be inferred from school boycott participation or number of cities.

location.summary: CIVICUS mentions an undated egg incident at the Education Ministry and student street activity in many cities; a Jan27 Nova Makedonija result mentions partial protests in Skopje and Kumanovo without exact sites. Relationship is not established.

demands.summary: The broader matura reporting describes a request to reduce exams from four to two, while CIVICUS describes discontent with a forthcoming online examination procedure; these accounts may relate but do not prove one event or demand set.

participants_original.summary: No physical gathering count. Boycott participation/school totals are not crowd attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No estimate establishes at least 50 people in any one possible physical gathering.

notes: One unresolved lead, not two candidate observations. CIVICUS's undated school-exam discussion mentions both egg throwing at the Ministry and students taking to streets in many cities; Jan27 Nova Makedonija search text separately mentions partial protests in Skopje/Kumanovo. No evidence establishes whether these refer to the same or separate acts, their physical dates, precise locations, attendance, or whether the CIVICUS items began in January. Keep the dated Jan21 class boycott excluded and do not turn class participation into crowd size.
open_questions: Determine whether any public assembly occurred in January and establish its physical date and exact site.
Resolve whether the egg-throwing and reported partial street protests were one or more acts, and whether they relate to the matura boycott.
Establish at least 50 simultaneous attendees and event-specific response.
